landmarks.name: Baalbek
landmarks.writeup: Ancient Roman temple complex known for its grand architecture and historical significance.

landmarks.name: Jeita Grotto
landmarks.writeup: A system of interconnected limestone caves famous for its stunning stalactites and stalagmites.

landmarks.name: Byblos
landmarks.writeup: One of the oldest continuously inhabited cities in the world, rich in archaeological sites.

landmarks.name: Cedars of God
landmarks.writeup: Ancient cedar forest, symbolizing Lebanon and mentioned in various historical texts.

landmarks.name: Beirut National Museum
landmarks.writeup: Houses a vast collection of archaeological artifacts showcasing Lebanon's history.

cultural_events.name: Beirut International Film Festival
cultural_events.writeup: Annual event showcasing regional and international films, promoting cultural exchange.

cultural_events.name: Byblos International Festival
cultural_events.writeup: Music and arts festival held in the ancient city of Byblos featuring global artists.

cultural_events.name: Mawazine Festival
cultural_events.writeup: Celebrates Lebanese music and culture with performances across the country.

food_writeup: Lebanese cuisine is known for its use of fresh ingredients, olive oil, herbs, and spices, featuring dishes like hummus, tabbouleh, kibbeh, and manakish.
brief_history: Lebanon has a rich history dating back to ancient Phoenician civilization. It has been influenced by various empires including Roman, Ottoman, and French. Lebanon gained independence in 1943 and has experienced periods of conflict and cultural flourishing.

important_people.name: Rafic Hariri
important_people.description: Former Prime Minister and influential political figure

current_conflicts: Lebanon faces political instability, economic crisis, and tensions related to Hezbollah's role and regional conflicts impacting its security.
